```python
def greet(name: str) -> str:
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

    return sum(numbers) / len(numbers)
```

sections.title: process_value(), first_element(), reverse_list()
sections.body:
Process different types Get first element or None Reverse a list

```python
def process_value(value: Union[int, str, float]) -> str:
    """Process different types"""
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return f"Integer: {value}"
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        return f"String: {value}"
    else:
        return f"Float: {value}"

print(f"find_user(1): {find_user(1)}")
print(f"find_user(99): {find_user(99)}")
print(process_value(42))
print(process_value("hello"))
print(process_value(3.14))

# ============================================================================
# EXAMPLE 4: Generic Types with TypeVar
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 4: Generic Types with TypeVar")
print("=" * 70)

T = TypeVar("T")

def first_element(items: List[T]) -> Optional[T]:
    """Get first element or None"""
    return items[0] if items else None

def reverse_list(items: List[T]) -> List[T]:
    """Reverse a list"""
    return items[::-1]

numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
words = ["apple", "banana", "cherry"]

print(f"first_element({numbers}): {first_element(numbers)}")
print(f"first_element({words}): {first_element(words)}")
print(f"reverse_list({numbers}): {reverse_list(numbers)}")
print(f"reverse_list({words}): {reverse_list(words)}")

# ============================================================================
```
```python
# EXAMPLE 11: Generic Repository Pattern
# ============================================================================
print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("EXAMPLE 11: Generic Repository Pattern")
print("=" * 70)

class Repository(Generic[T]):
    def __init__(self):
        self._items: List[T] = []
        self._next_id = 1

    def add(self, item: T) -> int:
        self._items.append(item)
        item_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        return item_id

    def get(self, index: int) -> Optional[T]:
        if 0 <= index < len(self._items):
            return self._items[index]
        return None

    def all(self) -> List[T]:
        return self._items.copy()

    def count(self) -> int:
        return len(self._items)

# String repository
str_repo: Repository[str] = Repository()
str_repo.add("Alice")
str_repo.add("Bob")
str_repo.add("Charlie")

print(f"String repository count: {str_repo.count()}")
print(f"All items: {str_repo.all()}")
print(f"Item at index 1: {str_repo.get(1)}")
```
